notes.title: The Ultimate Patch 1.5.0
notes.notes:
The Ultimate Patch 

We have reviewed all of your feedback and over the past few days we have compiled it into one large Patch. We present to you: The Ultimate Patch. This covers almost every problem that Cod Quest has faced. 

 Addressing multiplayer issues 

Single-player on Cod Quest is usually bugless and a blast, however multiplayer has always been a different story - Until Now.

- Fixed War Achievements not working for clients
- Fixed Barry calls not syncing for all clients
- Fixed the Victory cutscenes not playing when you win the war
- Added security features to handle item duping
- Players no longer collide with each other
- Players don't spawn outside the shop anymore
- Fixed deliveries sometimes not arriving

 Main game fixes 

- Items no longer phase through the floor when thrown down
- You can now throw items regardless of what you are looking at
- No longer can throw items outdoors
- Cannot clip through walls by placing furniture near yourself
- Fridges now keep everything in the same order
- Upgrading the store no longer clips you outside
- You can no longer put drinks into food fridges
- Fixed options sometimes not saving/loading

For your convenience (QOL)

Features that make your life, easier.

- Finally added the highly requested volume and mouse sensitivity sliders
- Shoplifters are slower at running
- More time to react to shoplifters
- Mouse no longer gets stuck at the bottom of screen
- You can now SHIFT+CLICK an item in the fridge to take out all
- Made scrolling on some menus a lot faster

A few extras *wink*

- Made researching items a little more obvious (Press R btw)

FYI's

(i) You can research new recipes by opening the recipe book (R). Having a larger product variety will give you a better customer rate and more money per order as customers prioritise your best food.

(i) Hiring soldiers for the war will make the War Bar decrease slower - This makes beating war much easier especially if you have varied and stronger troops.

(i) There's no need to stress about orders. If a customer leaves before you can even take their order, this won't actually affect your store in any way shape or form. The only thing to worry about, is serving customers wrong or too slow (one's which orders have already been taken)

(i) Customers being rude or angry? Or you're just feeling cheeky? You can cough on their tasty meals before serving them (Press C and look at the food). Don't get mad at me if they sue you though!

Thank you!

At BWOM, we have loved every second of Cod Quest's journey so far. We love hearing your requests and feedback as it allows us to shape the game into its absolute best state. We're planning to release actual updates soon, especially now that we have a lot of bugs off our shoulders.

We appreciate every one of you for your input, as always, please let us know if you find anything strange or report-worthy in Cod Quest.

From The BWOM Team.
